_note: Used by: python report_job.py --due (run it once a day). Three groups = three Excel files, two sheets each: yearly (run on 1 Jan for last year; procedures take the year), quarterly (1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct for the quarter just ended; procedures take the first and last day of the quarter), monthly (1st of each month for the month just ended; procedures take the first and last day of the month). Change "day" if the data needs a few days to close. Optional per report: "mail_to" (list of recipients, default MAIL_TO), "title", "columns", "table", "hierarchy", "period", "period_rule". Not scheduled on purpose: LAISUAT_SPTK (reserve-requirement scenario, run by hand in SSMS). See README.md. "groups" gives the file and email name of each group; {period} becomes "tháng 01/2024", "quý IV/2024" or "năm 2024" (the file name uses - instead of /). Snapshot reports (cơ cấu tiền gửi, cơ cấu dư nợ) compare two points in time, so their start date is the last day of the previous quarter: {day_before_from}. Reports that count every day of a range (lãi, phí) start on the first day: {from_date}.
